review_evidence: README describes reusable components for Lean-related websites; inspection found 41 Lean files and roughly 155 declaration-shaped definitions/instances.
VersoWeb/Util.lean and VersoWeb/Features.lean define reusable transformations and typed feature interfaces such as extractText, truncateHtml, createSlug, diff/diffs, and markup roles.
The repository has no test/generated subtree in the reviewed manifest whose removal is demonstrably lossless for definitions or interfaces.
summary: Retain the Verso web-component source set: it is a compact library of reusable typed components and transformations, with no demonstrated generated or maintenance-only subtree.
